name: timepicker
need: Pick a time of day: type it or choose it from a list, in 12 or 24 hours as the locale has it

--ds-timepicker-option-height.description: a row of the list of times at size md and the comfortable density

labExempt.DS.timepicker.times: pure date math or text from Intl: no DOM, no motion
labExempt.DS.timepicker.list: a listbox in place: its active row's layer is a state layer, nothing moves; the time picker demo plays it in its popover

ripple..ds-timepicker__option: a click picks the time and closes the popover; the active row's layer is the feedback
